title: Reliability-Aware Short-Term Glycemic Risk Prediction Using an Anchor-Based Comparative Framework of Sequence, Multimodal, and State-Updating Digital-Twin Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anticipating short-term hypoglycemic and hyperglycemic risk is essential for proactive diabetes management. However, existing machine learning approaches often use inconsistent evaluation protocols and emphasize predictive performance over reliability. This study introduces an anchor-based benchmarking framework integrating longitudinal glucose sequences and multimodal patient information. Using the T1DiabetesGranada dataset, 5,503,441 standardized prediction anchors were constructed from 736 individuals with type 1 diabetes to evaluate hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute horizons. Three neural architectures, a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer, a Multimodal Digital Twin, and a State-Updating Digital Twin with gap-aware longitudinal state progression, were compared under identical patient-level validation protocols. translated_title: 基于锚点的序列、多模态与状态更新数字孪生模型比较框架的可靠性感知短期血糖风险预测
translated_abstract: 预测短期低血糖和高血糖风险对于糖尿病的主动管理至关重要。然而，现有的机器学习方法通常采用不一致的评估协议，并且过分强调预测性能而忽视可靠性。本研究引入了一个整合纵向血糖序列与多模态患者信息的基于锚点的基准测试框架。利用T1DiabetesGranada数据集，从736名1型糖尿病患者中构建了5,503,441个标准化预测锚点，用于评估30分钟、60分钟和120分钟时间范围内的低血糖和高血糖预测。在完全相同的患者级验证协议下，比较了三种神经架构：混合LSTM-Transformer、多模态数字孪生，以及具有间隙感知纵向状态推进的状态更新数字孪生。除预测性能外，评估还考察了校准、分类阈值等可靠性指标。
tldr: 本研究提出基于锚点的比较基准框架，利用736名1型糖尿病患者的550余万个标准化预测锚点，在统一的患者级评估协议下比较混合LSTM-Transformer、多模态数字孪生与状态更新数字孪生三种神经架构在30/60/120分钟血糖风险预测中的表现，并同时评估校准等可靠性指标。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an anchor-based comparative benchmarking framework that evaluates three neural architectures—Hybrid LSTM-Transformer, Multimodal Digital Twin, and State-Updating Digital Twin—for short-term hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction at 30/60/120-minute horizons using over 5.5 million standardized anchors from 736 T1D patients, emphasizing reliability metrics such as calibration beyond predictive performance.
